review:
Monster Hunt is a horror-themed 25-line slot where citizens reward your monster-hunting with coins. Six or more coins trigger Horror Respin, a Hold and Win-style round.

During Horror Respin, filling one horizontal line with coins wins the Mini jackpot (20x), and further lines award the Mega (100x) and Grand (1,000x) jackpots. A bonus buy can trigger either the free spins or Horror Respin directly where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 1,299x maximum, a low ceiling. The RTP is 94.65%. Free spins arrive frequently, about once every 98 spins, so sessions tend to be lively if not explosive.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 98 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
